goal: Gate enforces ASP303 (error swallowed into a success sentinel) with fixtures.
acceptance_criteria: the gate fires ASP303 on its violating fixture and exits 1
the gate is silent for ASP303 on its satisfying fixture and exits 0

acceptance_tests.description: the gate fires ASP303 on its violating fixture and exits 1
the gate is silent for ASP303 on its satisfying fixture and exits 0

problem: Aspergillus ships a Rust gate over a Cargo workspace. This spec pins that the rule(s) named in the goal are enforced (blocking, with committed violating/satisfying fixtures) or documented as not-applicable in docs/design.md, graded deterministically against the integration branch.
